header.headline: Cookie policy
header.subhead: What this site stores on your device and why.

principles: No advertising cookies. No cross-site tracking. No data sale.
Non-essential measurement, if introduced, will require consent where the law demands it and will be listed here before it runs.

cookies.name: session / preference
cookies.purpose: Keeps basic site preferences (such as dismissed banners) working during your visit.

cookies.name: security / rate-limit
cookies.purpose: Protects forms and endpoints from abuse.

cookies.name: aggregate analytics
cookies.purpose: Counts page views to guide content work. Aggregated; not used for profiling.
cookies.consent: Required where applicable; disabled until granted

management.title: Managing cookies
management.body: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may break contact forms. Withdrawal of consent for optional cookies can be done at any time via the preference control or by clearing site data.
